items.title: First-price auction
clues: I am a way of settling a sale.
The winner pays exactly their own bid.
items.why: In a first-price auction the winner pays what they bid.

items.title: Bid request
clues: I go from a seller to many buyers.
I describe an impression for sale.
items.why: The bid request is how a seller offers an impression to buyers.

items.title: Deal ID
clues: I link a buyer and a seller’s agreement.
items.why: A deal ID tells the systems which agreement an impression belongs to.
